verdict.rationale: Blaxel's core product is cloud sandboxes for code execution, so AI-generated code runs on Blaxel's hosted infrastructure rather than the developer's own. Its docs cover running shell commands and processes in sandboxes, per-domain egress allow/deny lists to prevent data exfiltration, a proxy with secret injection, and running workloads as an unprivileged non-root user. Missing for 10: documentation of the underlying isolation boundary (e.g. microVM vs container) and resource limits, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the security claims.
